sys_atf_test.description: Validates that the Lock Contract Type business rule blocks a non-admin user from changing contract_type when type-specific cost data (CPFF fee) exists. Creates a proposal with contract_type=cpff, adds a CPFF fee record, then attempts to change contract_type to tm as a non-admin user and asserts the update is rejected.
sys_atf_test.name: Contract Type Lock - Non-Admin Blocked
